purpose: EC/EO Berger baseline 5-tier perfect protocol — guarantee user one-shot PASS on first --fire after hardware reseat. $0 mac-native, ~5-7 min wall.

manual_steps: Cyton power OFF -> wait 5s -> PC mode (USB-PC, NOT BLE)
O2 + P4 explicit re-seat with saline 1-2 drops + scalp contact

tier2_pre_berger_sanity_30s.behavior_on_fail: abort main capture, emit recipe (which electrodes to re-seat)

cue_script.preamble: 5초 후 측정을 시작합니다. 화면 안내를 따라주세요.

tier4_capture_orchestration.method: direct collect.hexa subprocess (bypasses berger_session_audio wrapper BRAINFLOW_TIMEOUT)

falsifiers.F_BERGER_1: EC/EO occipital alpha ratio >= 1.5 on at least one of O1/O2
falsifiers.F_BERGER_2: EC occipital alpha sum > EC frontal alpha sum

tier5_post_capture_falsifiers.recipe_on_fail: bilingual EN+KO bullet list keyed on each failed falsifier

honest_c3.claim: Tier 1 manual reseat is user hands-on; this script cannot guarantee good electrode contact. Worst case: user fires before saline applied, Tier 1 impedance fails, recipe emitted, retry needed.

5/5 scenario PASS based on numpy-generated waveforms. First real-hardware fire may surface failure modes not modeled (e.g., 60Hz line noise, motion artefact, intermittent dongle dropout). Tier 5 recipe is generic; specific channel naming may need tuning after real-data review.

Alpha [1, 100] uV^2 / EOG <5x / cross-corr <0.95 / Berger ratio >=1.5 are anima-internal heuristics derived from 2026-05-03+04 capture audit (v6 board contamination + O2/P4 anomaly). Not literature universal cutoffs. Tunable in source constants block.
say -v Yuna requires macOS Korean voice installed. Falls back to text-print only if /usr/bin/say missing or voice unavailable. Non-Mac platforms: no audio cue (visible cue print to stdout only).

Passing this 5-tier baseline is a NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT condition for the Phase E main 15-min reading protocol. The longer protocol has additional failure modes (drift, fatigue, cap migration over 15 min) that this 60s-block test cannot validate.
Orchestrator lives at tool/transient_py/ per anima .own opt-out namespace. Not git-tracked unless deliberately added. Bash wrapper at bin/ IS git-tracked and is the user-facing entrypoint.
